notes: Faster, and drafting that feels like CAD. GeoWorks opens in about a third of the time (2.1 s, was 5.8 s); a drawing of 100 000 lines loads in half a second; the window no longer freezes when a surface lands, on the first GNSS import, after registering a scan, or while a stockpile report is written. Drafting: the command line asks AutoCAD's way, type distance / bearing / height at the cursor, right-click tools, Properties say Varies, Quick select, layer freeze and plot in the layer's row. New: Plan + 3D side by side, saved layer views, your own one-letter keys (Settings > Keys), workspaces (Survey, Drafting, Design, Scan), and hiding a layer now hides its survey points. Fixed: Job defaults fits a laptop screen; side-panel buttons on the Surface page are no longer cut off; a second GeoWorks opened during an update no longer spoils it.
